text: Maria Demko's birth record is believed to be in the Uzhhorod archives and has not been located.
The family comes from Senné and Iňačovce, Michalovce District. Which village belongs to which surname was not said.
Kevin leans toward a Rusyn origin for the Demko side and is open to being wrong. He describes his heritage as Carpatho-Rusyn and Slovak.
Kevin was raised by his paternal grandparents, the Duskas. Family knowledge of Maria Demko therefore comes through her son's household.
Kevin runs his own Duska one-name study site. Following the Duska agent's rule, that site stays unread until the comparison phase, so this rebuild remains independent of his earlier conclusions.
